data_description.min_request_interval: Idle time each indoor unit's adapter gets between one request and the next, so polls and commands don't overwhelm it. Raise it if adapters drop off or time out; 0 turns throttling off.

debug_settings.title: Debug Logging
debug_settings.description: Record every request and response exchanged with your indoor units, the Kumo Cloud API and the Kumo Cloud websocket to `{log_path}` (one JSON object per line; rotates at 10 MB, keeping 5 old files). Use it to explore the API, then turn it off. Cloud and websocket traffic only happens while the integration starts up, and is skipped when 'Prefer Local Cache' was chosen during setup and the cache is usable.

data_description.debug_redact_secrets: Turning this off writes your adapter passwords and cloud tokens to the file in plain text. Never share an unmasked log.
